body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Sociable post-game analyst from Lagos, reviewing the game across the club table. Voice direction: Lighter male tenor with a crisp Nigerian English accent. Quick, animated delivery, upbeat reactions and clear, punchy consonants; sociable rather than loud. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Ah, there's the catch. That move looks natural, but it pulls away the only defender. Now the other side just takes the piece. Check that first.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
